Hi Sara / Partner Center team,

Thanks for approving the referral into Partner Center for Contoso (they're evaluating an LLM-hosted inference proof-of-concept). Quick intake to get the field ownership and co-sell mechanics aligned so we can schedule a joint kickoff next week. High-level ask: can Microsoft confirm seller-of-record or the field contact who should be looped for co-sell (and any local seller territory)? Contoso's contact info below.

Contoso contact:
- Sara Jenkins (IT Director) — sara.jenkins@contoso.com — +1 206-555-0134
- High-level need: secure LLM inference for internal knowledge search POC, ~1k users, data isolation requirements.

What we need from Partner Center to proceed:
1) Partner Center case id for the referral (so our MCX/field can link).
2) Assigned Microsoft seller or seller team (name + email).
3) Any co-sell intake checklist or local documentation we should fill out (SOW template, buyer procurement steps).

I'll also attach a preliminary account map (accounts and contacts) so the seller can own outreach.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
